title: Numbers Bible Quiz - Chapter 36
description: Ten questions on Numbers 36: the inheritance of the daughters of Zelophehad and the rule that it must stay in their tribe.

questions.text: The heads of which family came to Moses about the inheritance?
questions.explanation: The heads of the fathers' households of the family of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, came and spoke before Moses.

answers.text: The family of Gilead, of Manasseh
The family of Korah, of Levi
The family of Hezron, of Judah
The family of Hanoch, of Reuben

questions.text: Whose daughters had been given an inheritance?
questions.explanation: Moses had been commanded by Yahweh to give the inheritance of Zelophehad to his daughters.

answers.text: Jephunneh's
Ammihud's
Zelophehad's
Manasseh's

questions.text: What were the leaders worried would happen if the daughters married men from other tribes?
questions.explanation: Their inheritance would be taken from the inheritance of their fathers and added to the tribe they married into.

answers.text: They would lose their father's name
Their inheritance would pass to another tribe
They would have to leave the camp
Their land would go to the Levites

questions.text: At what event did they say the inheritance would be added to the other tribe?
questions.explanation: They said that when the jubilee of the children of Israel came, the inheritance would be added to the tribe to which the daughters belonged.

answers.text: The Passover
The feast of weeks
The day of blowing of trumpets
The jubilee

questions.text: What did Moses say about the complaint of the tribe of the sons of Joseph?
questions.explanation: Moses commanded according to Yahweh's word, saying, "The tribe of the sons of Joseph speak what is right."

answers.text: That they should not have complained
That the matter must wait for the jubilee
That they spoke what is right
That the priests must decide it

questions.text: Whom were the daughters of Zelophehad allowed to marry?
questions.explanation: They could marry whom they thought best, only they had to marry into the family of the tribe of their father.

answers.text: Anyone they chose within their father's tribe
Only men from the tribe of Judah
Only men from the tribe of Levi
Anyone at all, from any tribe of Israel

questions.text: What was the purpose of this rule?
questions.explanation: So no inheritance of the children of Israel would move from tribe to tribe, but each would keep the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.

answers.text: That the land would be divided equally
That the daughters would stay unmarried
That Joseph would receive a double portion
That no inheritance would move from tribe to tribe

questions.text: Which of these was one of the daughters of Zelophehad?
questions.explanation: The daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah and Noah.

answers.text: Miriam
Tirzah
Zipporah
Deborah

questions.text: Whom did the daughters of Zelophehad marry?
questions.explanation: They were married to their father's brothers' sons, in the families of the sons of Manasseh.

answers.text: Their father's brothers' sons
Sons of Caleb
Men of the tribe of Gad
Sons of Eleazar the priest

questions.text: Where did Yahweh give these commandments and ordinances to Israel through Moses?
questions.explanation: They were commanded by Moses to the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

answers.text: At Mount Sinai
At Kadesh Barnea
In the plains of Moab
In the wilderness of Zin
